result.summary: The environment is highly car-centric with a complete lack of visible pedestrian infrastructure at a large, multi-lane intersection. Large vehicles in the foreground create significant visual obstructions, and there are no marked crossings or sidewalks visible to support safe pedestrian movement.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or sidewalks are visible, forcing pedestrians to navigate a high-volume traffic environment without protection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large pickup trucks in the foreground significantly block sightlines between drivers and any potential pedestrians at the intersection level.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway requires a long unprotected crossing time for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns and pedestrian countdown signals at all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised median islands to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians and reduce the effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Network Completion
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians separated from traffic.

result.summary: The intersection is highly car-centric, lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and commercial surroundings prioritize high-speed vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety and access.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, sidewalks, and pedestrian signals, providing no safe space or guidance for people walking.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane arterial creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark all legs of the intersection with continental-style crosswalks to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Construct Paved Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install continuous paved sidewalks along the roadway to provide physical separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide safe crossing intervals.

result.summary: The intersection is highly car-oriented with a complete lack of visible pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or signals. The wide roadway and large crossing distances create a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this large intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the road requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire width of the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signals are visible to manage safe crossing times.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic signal mast arms.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show the remaining time to cross safely.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a marked crosswalk but no protected refuge or signalization. The lack of a paved sidewalk on the right side and the long, exposed crossing distance create a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk Infrastructure
hazards.description: The crosswalk terminates in a grassy area with no paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the grass or on the road shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where the crosswalk meets the curb

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The large white truck parked or stopped on the right shoulder blocks sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Build a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the road to provide a safe, accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to stop high-speed traffic and provide a protected crossing interval.
